svg.title: Confirmed wiring from the ZXpand+'s DB9 adapter to a generic USB-serial TTL adapter
svg.desc: A DB9 male connector is drawn with its standard 5-pin top row and 4-pin bottom row, staggered to match the real connector shape. Pins 5, 8, and 9 are highlighted as TX, GND, and RX respectively. The remaining six pins are shown in gray as unused. Routed lines connect these three pins to a generic USB-serial adapter's GND, TXD, and RXD pins below, with TX and RX crossing to the adapter's opposite-named pins.
svg.text: Teal = confirmed pins (TX=5, GND=8, RX=9) · Gray = other DB9 pins, not used here
